label: Parent normal-URL inspection before planned Build44, not independent review

method.input: Existing visible driver and ordinary synthetic keyboard/mouse. Held-RMB capture used to correct capacitor aim.

observations: Opening optic burst killed Warden. Jumped east low cover and entered workshop approach. Roof, supports, worklights and open west side provided distinct framing; detailed roof/rain correctness remains separate engineering evidence.

Used held ADS image to see cabinet aim was near its frame edge, corrected left/down, fired one round, saw warning, then waited1100ms without further fire. Cabinet became spent, adjacent particles/supply appeared and kills1→2 with ammo25 unchanged. This supports a discharge elimination; exact damage not measured here.

West E hold failed at3.2m. Parent wrongly sent a return command before inspecting that result, ran toward extraction with two memories, then returned and sidestepped to secure Mara. Same attempt, no reset or failed start discarded.

Last live upload frame showed100health/41shield and54%; despite filename uplink-cover.jpg it shows the exposed gap BETWEEN the plates, not a proven protected stance. A later left move and wait completed upload. Final health is not inferred.
No dash used in this attempt. This is not natural phase mastery, human enjoyment, audio listening or hardware validation.

Known-route run used only one rifle elimination plus environmental kill; it does not establish that combat is excessive or insufficient for all players. Together with fresh reviewers stating limited encounter breadth and forgiving objective rushing, it motivates an explicit combat climax as a creative design change.

nextDesign.name: The Custodian
nextDesign.decision: A Blender-authored uplink-security capstone with three destructible broadcast coils, readable charge/exposure and phase-interrupt opportunities. All three memories plus disabling the Custodian precede existing upload.
nextDesign.why: Give the rifle, cover and phase toolkit a deliberate final encounter and tangible component progress, increasing combat breadth beyond repeating recoveries.
nextDesign.changesFromOldDesign: Combat can remain optional during recovery, but the finale requires disabling a physical jammer. Replace the two extraction interceptors with one Custodian, proposed finite roster12 instead13; retain other actor and weapon rules.
nextDesign.candidateImplementation: A stationary mechanical emplacement visible in standby from mission start, activated after final recovery. Candidate east forecourt around11,16 subject to real clearance, vista, cover and targeting validation. Three160-base-health components, existing weapon damage values, reduced volley as coils fail, normal firing exposure plus phase-forced opening. Exact tuning must be tested.
tradeoffs: Longer, more demanding finale and revised victory criteria; prior completion rates are historical and not final-boss evidence.
New mechanical attack, targeting, lifecycle and physical ownership introduce real verification work.
Needs ordinary discovery and actual successful combat, not just arranged node destruction or privileged victory.
